this page is to explain where to go every day to farm materials we desperately need for the guild. you can do these on one or all characters, or anything in between, as any amount will be appreciated.

for all these it could help to go to the guild hall and drink the free 24h critical gathering potion at the tavern, as it will add up in the end. also keep an eye out for harvesting banners as these hotspots are being frequented by a lot of people. it is always a good idea to mine/chop/harvest any node you come across, so dont be lazy and move those 50 extra paces so you can snag the elder wood node along the way!

* **flax**: we need flax to make lineseed oil, which we need for barrels to upgrade the tavern. on the most recent calculation we needed over 20k flax seeds, so we recommend you park all your characters you do not use at the hotspot. log in, farm, donate will net us around 11 flax per toon. [elder wood map 1](https://gw2efficiency.com/assets/gathering/permanent/Machor's%20Leap%20-%20Perma%20Elder%20Wood.jpg) [&BKYCAAA=] [elder wood map 2](https://gw2efficiency.com/assets/gathering/permanent/Straits%20of%20Devastation%20-%20Perma%20Elder%20Wood.jpg) [&BPgCAAA=]

* **mithril ore**: we need mithril ore to make bars. we need bars for upgrades in general as well as for crafting empty kegs. there are multiple permanent rich mithril nodes.
